trust_decision.summary: The async (non-blocking) UTF-8 JSON parser decides whether the integer digits accumulated so far exceed StreamReadConstraints.maxNumberLength; this is done in _setIntLength -> validateIntegerLength, but at the pinned commit only when the integer part ends (separator, '.', 'e', EOF), not on NOT_AVAILABLE exits mid-number. Meanwhile digits keep going into an unbounded TextBuffer.expandCurrentSegment.

landing_point.why: The summary mentions async 'chunked digit accumulation'. _finishNumberIntegralPart is the resume function for MINOR_NUMBER_INTEGER_DIGITS (NonBlockingUtf8JsonParserBase.java:252-254), and its NOT_AVAILABLE exit at :1694-1698 is the obvious place to look. The fraction and exponent paths beside it already validate on their NA exits (:1741, :1835, :1798, :1905), which makes the gap stand out.

fix_sites.entry_point: JsonFactory.createNonBlockingByteArrayParser()/createNonBlockingByteBufferParser() + feedInput + nextToken(); first chunk of an unsigned number (_startPositiveNumber(int))
same factories + nextToken(); first chunk of a '-'-prefixed number (_startNegativeNumber)
same factories + nextToken() with JsonReadFeature.ALLOW_LEADING_PLUS_SIGN_FOR_NUMBERS; first chunk of a '+'-prefixed number (_startPositiveNumber())
fix_sites.module_kind: core async parser (same class), feature-gated input

fix_sites.entry_point: same factories + nextToken(); resume of integer digits after a chunk boundary (_finishToken MINOR_NUMBER_INTEGER_DIGITS, :252-254), also reached from leading-zero and +/- split paths (:1575, :1622, :1683)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All four sites are in one class, src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/core/json/async/NonBlockingUtf8JsonParserBase.java. Both public parsers (NonBlockingJsonParser, NonBlockingByteBufferJsonParser) inherit it, and neither has its own number code.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver could argue that the three _start*Number NA exits only buffer one caller-supplied chunk, and that the _finishNumberIntegralPart check fires on the next resume, so the start-function sites are 'not an accumulation route'. The published tests (chunksFed <= 2, fix.diff:154) do not contradict this.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: An integer just under maxNumberLength that is split across many small chunks must still parse to the exact text. The leading '-' sign must not count toward the limit; a check on TextBuffer size including the sign rejects one chunk early (fix.diff:375-378).

O6_input_shapes: unsigned integer digits split across chunks (fix.diff:22)
resumed integer digits incl. after leading zeroes or a split sign (fix.diff:49)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Drop the _setFractLength call on the NOT_AVAILABLE exit of _finishFloatFraction, so fraction digits accumulate unchecked across chunks
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This is the prior advisory's (GHSA-72hv-8253-57qq) NA-exit check. A maintainer who copied the int-path NA exit, which had no check, could have left it out.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Drop _setExpLength on the NOT_AVAILABLE exit of _finishFloatExponent, so exponent digits accumulate unchecked
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The exponent is a separate resume function with its own state. It looks like a 'neighbouring feature' a solver focused on integers would dismiss.

O9_family: CWE-770 allocation without limits: a length constraint is checked only at token completion in a streaming parser

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add _setIntLength(outPtr+negMod) only at the _finishNumberIntegralPart NA exit (:1694-1698); per fix.diff:154 this already passes the published tests.

out_of_scope_notes: TextBuffer.expandCurrentSegment (src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/core/util/TextBuffer.java:1086-1097) applies no length validation, unlike finishCurrentSegment (:1017); a different protection (maxStringLength) and layer.
EOF path at NonBlockingUtf8JsonParserBase.java:364-368 counts a leading '+' toward the length (off-by-one, stricter); not a bypass.
